description: A breakpoint envelope editor, such as an ADSR shape or an automation curve: points to drag, add and remove, segments to bend, a grid to snap to, and the point's index in each change. Its svelte adapter.

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import Polyline from "./Polyline.svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts.ts";

/** The area under the curve: an `<svg>` over the graph, filled with its `color`. */
let { ...rest }: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Fill>, "children"> = $props();
</script>

<parts.Fill {...rest}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    <Polyline filled points={state.points} />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Fill>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import Polyline from "./Polyline.svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts.ts";

/** The curve through the points: an `<svg>` over the graph, drawn in its `color`. */
let {
  strokeWidth,
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Line>, "children" | "strokeWidth"> & {
  strokeWidth?: number;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Line {...rest} {strokeWidth}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    <Polyline points={state.points} strokeWidth={strokeWidth ?? 2} />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Line>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
let {
  filled = false,
  points,
  strokeWidth = 2,
}: { filled?: boolean; points: string; strokeWidth?: number } = $props();
</script>

{#if filled}
  <polyline fill="currentColor" {points} stroke="none" />
{:else}
  <polyline
    fill="none"
    {points}
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    stroke-width={strokeWidth}
    style="vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke"
  />
{/if}
